2079-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2034-6006-6970-7175-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1086-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

670-1008-1619-3742.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1008-1619-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Undermountain Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1329-4211-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-5921-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve both Meticulous Artisan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4331-4993-5116-5645.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1268-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
1268-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

3055-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2557-4636-5770-6753.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

413-1339-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
413-1339-6713.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2105-2921-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-2921-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2743-3130-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Blue Sun's Twilight and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Blue Sun's Twilight copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

5670-5870-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-5870-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

5670-5931-6291.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-5931-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room // Awakening Hall triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1445-3821-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
1445-3821-6281.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Peregrine Drake, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Hashaton triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4359-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2060-3334-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Lae'zel, Vlaakith's Champion.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

575-4674-4677-4955.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
You have at least one green card in hand.
575-4674-4677-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Temur Charger.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Temur Charger enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card in your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1168-1651-2375-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Riveteers Overlook from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Riveteers Overlook enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Toggo.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Riveteers Overlook trigger, causing you to sacrifice it then search your library for a basic Forest, Mountain, or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

984-1494-4982.description:
Cast Awakened Awareness for X=4 by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Awakened Awareness enters the battlefield, putting four +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next extra turn's upkeep, Riptide Chimera triggers, causing you to return Awakened Awareness from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3101-3368-4036-4833.description:
Cast Seething Song.
In response, cast Reiterate, targeting Seething Song and paying the buyback cost.
After Reiterate and the copy of Seething Song resolve, cast Reiterate targeting Seething Song and paying the buyback cost.
Remove three +1+1 counters from Runaway Steam-Kin to produce {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat the loop from step 3, removing counters from Runaway Steam-Kin for mana every three iterations.

1309-3557-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
1309-3557-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

757-2402-4883.notablePrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it.
757-2402-4883.description:
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Magosi to Nesting Grounds.
Activate Magosi's last ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it to your hand, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi from your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Nesting Grounds.
Activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Nesting Grounds to Magosi.
Repeat from step 3.
